name: m5-t8-uniques-paired

variantDescriptions.kwu: `ChunkedInterner(weak = true)`, and types made in the weak scopes not interned
variantDescriptions.ksu: `ChunkedInterner(weak = false)`: no `WeakReference`, types held to the end of the run, and types made in the weak scopes not interned

description: 8 independent compiles at once (JMH `-t 8`, single shot: each iteration is 8 concurrent compiles of the scala corpus, each with a new `Global`), 24 GB G1 heap, laptop. Baseline vs chunked-weak + uncache-all vs chunked (strong) + uncache-all, the far corner, alternating by iteration within each fork. Asks whether uncache's GC savings (young-GC pauses -35% for one compile, job 557) pay when eight compiles share a heap. Build `claude/uniques-audit` `41986b33ea`.
